description: SONAX Xtreme Ceramic Tyre and Rim Detailer 750ml | High-Performance Tire & Wheel Cleaner | Water-Repellent, Dirt Protection, and Gloss Enhancer | Suitable for All Tire and Rim Types - Distributed/Packaged by Sonax. Product Details: Achieve an immaculate finish for your vehicle's tires and rims with SONAX XTREME Ceramic Tyre and Rim Detailer. This high-performance detailing spray deeply penetrates treated surfaces, providing a stain-free protective layer and impressive water-repellent effect. Suitable for all tire and rim types, it restores tires and rubber to their as-new, matte appearance while safeguarding against dirt, premature aging, cracking, and environmental influences. Regular use can even eliminate brown discoloration. Additionally, it gently removes light superficial dirt from rims without scratching, ensuring extreme smoothness and high gloss. Simplify your car care routine and enhance the longevity and appearance of your tires and rims with this versatile detailer. Application Instructions:- Preparation: Wash heavily soiled tires or rims. Lightly soiled or dusty surfaces can be treated directly. Shake Well: Ensure the bottle is well-shaken before use. Spray and Apply: Turn the nozzle to spray position. Spray the product onto a sponge applicator and apply evenly to the tire or rim surface. Wipe Off Residue: Use a dry microfiber cloth to wipe off any residue from the rim. Do not allow the product to dry. Repeat if Necessary: If colors appear irregular, repeat the application. Important Notes: Do not use on hot surfaces. Protect against frost.
